title: Our American cousin
html_source: Likely refers to the Tom Taylor play, a production of which President Abraham Lincoln was attending at Ford’s Theater when he was assassinated.

anchor.prefix: m. Warwickshire jesuits are tried and we have a porter's theory of equivocation. The Sea Venture comes home from Bermudas and the play Renan admired is written with Patsy Caliban,
anchor.suffix: . The sugared sonnets follow Sidney's. As for fay Elizabeth, otherwise carrotty Bess, the gross virgin who inspired The Merry Wives of Windsor, let some meinherr from Almany grope
